verdicts.reason: A: the bottle is the clear product hero and the headline, NEW badge and CTA sit together in one left-aligned column, but the bottle runs out past the bottom of its cream circle, the bottom ~200px of the canvas is empty, and the headline's 'Orange' comes close to the right edge. B: the bottle shrinks to a small thumbnail jammed into the top-left corner with a stray ghost circle clipped behind it; the NEW pill is blown up to nearly CTA size and competes with it; and the right-aligned buttons don't share an edge with the left-aligned headline, so the grid looks arbitrary and the bottom feels crowded.
